title: World Music Dance
shareTitle: World Music Dance 💃 — Dance Around the World
description: Pick a lantern on a cut-paper night map, meet a dancer, copy three real dance moves to the beat, and pin the dance card home on the world map. Six cultures, six dances, six songs.
learningGoals: Meet music and dance traditions from six world cultures
Match dance poses by careful watching (visual discrimination)
Find countries on a world map
Feel and move to different beats, scales, and tempos
interactionModel: Tap a map lantern to visit a culture; watch a beat-synced dancer; tap the matching pose card in a 3-step copy loop; drag the earned dance card onto its country.
feedbackModel: Warm recorded praise and sparkle SFX on success; a miss gets a gentle wiggle, spoken nudge, and a re-demonstration — after a second miss the correct card glows. No fail states.

modes.title: World Dance Festival
modes.skill: culture, geography, beat, and pose matching in one loop

credits: Rebuilt with Claude Code for QLOBE Kids.
